question: Do the three already frozen, physically weighted same-first-record private-error pair contrasts force a strictly positive lower bound on the ideal two-stage full-prior information about private error under either globally fixed public charge action, without filling missing laws?
fork_classification: The three preselected disjoint first-record strata and both separately fixed actions form one reversible zero-new-law exact-arithmetic matrix within the inherited small diagnostic budget. They test positive, null and action-sensitive finite contrasts together; no human ranking or new model choice is needed.

hypotheses.positive: At least one positive-TV pair has nonzero exact joint physical first-record mass, so binary Pinsker and the information chain rule yield a strictly positive full-prior information floor under each fixed action.
hypotheses.null_or_censored: If no action has a positive exact floor, or if matched first records, equal pair posterior, full-law replay, prior or source-integrity checks fail, withhold the full-prior information claim.
hypotheses.scope_limit: A positive floor concerns the private error E, not the logical class, actual channel information, adaptive schedule value, unconditional Boolean-union risk, noisy repeated measurement, size scaling or threshold.

model_boundary: Frozen R6AF ideal periodic L=2 D4 two-stage projector/fusion channel, 36 IID red-X edges with exact p_X=1/10 and p_Z=0. First observation is the complete public flux/charge/vacuum array; second observation is the complete action-conditioned public array. Each of [0] and [1,30,32,34,35] is treated as a separately precommitted relation-free public charge action, independent of private error. The same physical prior covers all 2^36 errors; private supports are analysis-only.

matrix.cells: Replay the three frozen J8V equal-prior pairs and all 12 stored complete conditional public second laws; cross-check J8W's exact pair joint first masses and six TVs. Keep all three disjoint full first records even if a cell is null.
matrix.estimand_and_bound: For each fixed action a, I(E;O2|O1,a) = sum_o P(o) I(E;O2|o,a). At each of the three disjoint selected first records o_i, define membership B_i in its two-error pair. Nonnegative chain-rule terms give P(o_i) I(E;O2|o_i,a) >= P(E in pair_i,o_i) JS(P_i,a,Q_i,a). The two errors have equal prior and equal first likelihood, and binary Pinsker gives JS >= TV(P_i,a,Q_i,a)^2/(2 ln 2) bits. Sum only these selected-record contributions; every omitted record and private error has nonnegative information contribution. Report an exact rational coefficient C_a = sum_i P(E in pair_i,o_i) TV_i,a^2 and the conservative bit floor C_a/(2 ln 2).
matrix.independent_unit: An exact private-error/complete-first-record/fixed-action law cell; no stochastic samples, fitted uncertainty or bootstrap interval.
matrix.integrity: Pin J8V contract/result and J8W result hashes; verify prior p_X/p_Z/edge count, three distinct complete first records, two distinct equal-weight three-edge errors per record, equal first likelihood, exact pair joint first mass, 12 normalized complete public second laws, both action IDs, exact recomputed TVs and source stability.

acceptance: All three first records and six pair/action TVs replay from the 12 complete public laws and physical prior
Both fixed-action exact rational coefficients and conservative bit floors are reported, including null cells and action-sensitive differences
Any positive inference is restricted to ideal private-error conditional information with no actual full-channel value, logical risk, noisy JIT or threshold promotion
stop_rule: Stop after the frozen three-stratum/two-action arithmetic matrix or first source/normalization/action/5-CPU-second failure. Do not generate missing laws, histories, arms, bootstrap replicates or extra sectors; no budget expansion.
